Parranda frontend workspace

This isolated static page proves that Astro, TypeScript and Parranda design tokens can build without changing the current Express production app.

Migration contract guardrails

  • Express remains the production source of truth
  • No production route takeover

Foundation only: no routing rewrite, no i18n rewrite, no Planner/Pulse/Blitz rewrite, no production takeover.
